title: The Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Coliseum on 1982-04-12
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi CR5A > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > R8Brain > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC 1644 Tagged. Transfer by Andrew F. 05/2011
source: AUD: 2x Nakamichi CM300's > Sony TC-D5M > TDK MA-90's. Set up behind the stage, recorded from the rear-facing P.A. system. Taped by Joe Morrone.

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording with a crystal‑clear Birdsong mix; the show is praised as nice overall.
ai_review.review: The behind‑the‑stage (audience) capture is hailed as the best‑sounding version on the archive, with very good clarity and a dialed‑in mix by Birdsong. Reviewers also note that the performance itself was enjoyable, though no specific songs are highlighted.

ai_rating.rationale: A single positive review emphasizes superb recording quality and a pleasant show, leading to a high rating despite limited data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Very good sound; mix is expertly balanced by Birdsong, described as the best‑sounding audience version on the archive.
